_comment: Tunable fraud-detection parameters. Editable by claims/business users without a code change. Both the agent's tools and the evaluation oracle read this file, exactly as they both read policies.json — shared reference data, independently implemented logic.
_late_reporting_days: Reporting a loss more than this many days after the incident is treated as an indicator.
_round_amount: Estimates at or above the minimum that are an exact multiple are treated as an indicator; precise figures suggest a real quote, round ones an estimate.
_theft_loss_types: Only these loss types are assessed for forced-entry evidence.
_forced_entry_evidence: Phrases showing a claimant DESCRIBED forced entry. Claimants report what they saw ('the door lock was broken'), never the absence of something.
_no_forced_entry: Phrases explicitly stating entry showed no force. Checked BEFORE the evidence list, because 'no forced entry' contains 'forced entry' as a substring.
